title: Mega Man Battle Network 2 - Battle Chip Library
summary: Every chip: 193 Standard and 57 Navi chips (the 250 shown in the in-game library), plus 16 extras that only appear when collected - 10 Network Exclusive, 5 Event Exclusive and 1 for beating Hard Mode. Chip data from the Mega Man Wiki (megaman.fandom.com, CC BY-SA).
